To: Lea Stone
Date written: December 12, 1846
Subject: Archive notice
Message-ID: MAIL-10793
The east depot reported receiving the alder memorandum sent by Lea Stone in response to the request of December 09, 1846.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.
